antithesis: I believe that exposing hepatocytes to 1064nm light at 282 THz could repair mitochondrial damage in Complex IV
synthesis: But prolonged exposure at 1064nm might generate too much heat and damage surrounding tissue in hepatocytes
conclusion: So the best approach is to apply dual-phase Hsp70 activation at 220 THz followed by main pulse at 370 THz with 30% reduced amplitude for 10 minutes targeting Complex IV in hepatocytes based on the 2024 findings about inflammation -30%
